links.scope: Fixed continuation of 20 original D4 cells; the 190-input panel and all earlier results remain intact.

question: What independently checked D4 codimension bounds hold on all 20 original fixed n43/n44 presentations under a 14 GiB single-worker cap?

claims.text: When the independently checked codimension lower bound exceeds the exact exhaustive solution count, the named presentation has last fall degree at least D+1.

arms.description: All 20 original n43/n44 D4 inputs in frozen plan order, ten per n with five polynomial and five random subspaces; original dense producer, independent checker and exhaustive counter.
Original independent checker and pinned exhaustive counter for each same named presentation.

aa.not_applicable_reason: Deterministic exact certificates, no runtime or frequency inference; historical digest replay measures exact reproducibility.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Historical 13-certificate replay is the positive correctness control, with hash identity and independent checking; software counter validation covers 188 full enumerations and four batch-boundary cross-checks.

negative.not_applicable_reason: No stochastic null inference. Corrupted certificate rejection and small all-pairs solution counts test false acceptance in software validation.

factors.name: input
factors.how: Per-instance seed from SHA256 of SEMAEV-PANEL-20261029-v1 plus newline plus stable instance id; Python Random and exact generator source frozen.

factors.name: instrument
factors.how: C source, M4RI commit and binary SHA256 retained.

factors.name: host
factors.how: CPU, kernel, process memory ceiling and L0 wall-valid=false; no timing inference.

factors.name: order
factors.how: Original n43 then n44 input order, one worker. Each item count, producer and checker are retained; no timing comparison.

factors.name: host_memory
factors.how: MemAvailable >=16 GiB immediately before each item; 14 GiB child address-space cap plus 2 GiB reserve. A low-memory gate pauses before the next input without creating a certificate outcome.

comparisons.threshold: Checker accepts and exact count < certified codimension; otherwise no LFD lower bound.

randomization.arm_order_reason: Exact named-input replay has no arm-dependent clock inference.

seed_derivation.note: seed = first 8 big-endian bytes of SHA256(UTF8(SEMAEV-PANEL-20261029-v1 + newline + fresh-n{n}-{family}-{rep:02d})); generator expand_instances.py is source-hashed.

instance_sampling.rule: All 20 already-frozen n43/n44 D4 presentations from the original 190-input plan, five polynomial and five random per n. No redraw, result-dependent omission or replacement.

blinding.how: Exact deterministic verification; labels required to reconstruct inputs, no blinded statistical analysis.

power.note: Twenty fixed original panel cells; exact named-input statements only, no population or asymptotic inference.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Twenty six-hour child watchdog allowances, not a runtime prediction.

primary.name: certified codimension lower bound
primary.definition: nq from an independently accepted surjective closure-separating map; not equality with closure codimension.

placement.checkpoint_detail: Per-input terminal result and inference; native closure has no in-progress checkpoint. A partial attempt requires artifact reconciliation before any retry.

stopping_rules.rule: Attempt the 20 exact original n43/n44 D4 inputs once in frozen plan order; six-hour watchdog per child command. No replacement or population inference.

At each input, if MemAvailable <16 GiB, stop before creating the next attempt and retain remaining cells as unknown. Partial, checker failure or count failure requires reconciliation, not automatic restart.

invalidation_rules: Unverified certificate yields no certified lower bound.
No public archive claim until anonymous download and SHA256 readback.

decision_rule.text: For each named D4 input, infer LFD >=5 only if the original independent checker accepts and the fresh exhaustive count is strictly below certified codimension. A resource gate, producer status or absent certificate is unknown.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: per-instance lower bound, no population inference

inputs: per-item exact counter and checker transcripts
outputs: n43n44-d4-resume-local-001 per-item gate and closed receipts

graphs: per-instance certificate status, no timing graph

inadmissible: Inferring LFD>=5 without original checker acceptance and strict fresh-count gap.
Treating a memory refusal, timeout, partial attempt or producer status as an upper bound.
Replacing a fixed original input or calling a pending n45 or D5 cell completed.
Using these exact named-input results as a population frequency, asymptotic or runtime claim.

literature.claim: Prior empirical degree five and distinct first-fall definition.

amendments.reason: Continue the already-frozen original panel after n42, under current shared-host capacity.
changes: Preserve the original 20 input records and order.
Use one local worker with a 14 GiB address-space cap and 2 GiB host reserve; stop before a low-memory input.
Keep the original independent checker, count and exact acceptance rule.
